day_shape: 43 items: IDF confirms overnight strikes on Hezbollah sites in Nabatieh and Ansar with Lebanese media reporting up to 11 dead, third reported Iranian attack this week on a UAE ADNOC vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran confirms three pilots held by Qatar since Esfand.

threads.label: Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed overnight airstrikes on Hezbollah infrastructure in the Nabatieh area and Ansar, saying they responded to an attack on troops at the Ali al-Taher Ridge. Lebanese media reported six to eleven killed; President Aoun called the strikes a violation of the framework agreement, and Hezbollah and IRIB said Netanyahu was escalating for electoral purposes.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz shipping and diplomacy
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported an ADNOC vessel was attacked by Iran while transiting the Strait, the third such attack in a week, with the UAE calling for the attacks to stop. Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Baghaei told Defa Press that Iran and Oman had reached agreement on a maritime traffic map for the Strait despite what he called American obstruction.

threads.label: Iranian pilots held in Qatar
threads.summary: Iran confirmed that three Iranian military pilots have been held by Qatari forces for six months after being captured following the crash of Su-24 fighters during Esfand attacks. Brigadier Bagherzadeh of the Armed Forces Missing Persons Search Committee made the statement to IRIB, and Iran International's report was picked up by the Jerusalem Post.

threads.label: Yemen front reporting
threads.summary: Defa Press reported continued Saudi artillery and rocket attacks on the Bani Sayah area and villages near Razih in Saada, without casualty figures. IRIB reported at least two severe explosions at a headquarters of Riyadh-aligned forces in Marib province, saying the Yemeni army and Ansar Allah targeted the site with two ballistic missiles.

threads.label: Iran wartime economy and messaging
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran's non-oil trade has fallen around 30% since the war began, with partner-country figures showing steeper declines in key relationships. Regime channels carried the Tehran mayor pledging free metro and buses until the war ends, an IRIB report of stable essential-goods prices, and multiple statements framing the recent conflict as an enemy miscalculation.

events.title_en: Al-Moussawi: Fall of Mosul is a test for defining state weapons
events.summary_en: Al-Moussawi: Fall of Mosul is a test for defining state weapons. Baghdad's Friday prayer leader, referring to recent controversies about the so-called 'monopoly of weapons in the hands of the state', said these discussions have been accompanied by considerable confusion and disarray in the political and media sphere. He warned against attempts to define the concept of 'state weapons' based on American perspective or political directives aimed at weakening Iraq. Al-Moussawi, referring to the events of Mosul's fall in 2014 and ISIS terrorist group's control of it, considered this event an example showing that merely holding the title of a military institution is not sufficient to guarantee the protection of the country.

events.title: Lebanese media reports six dead in an Israeli airstrike in southern Lebanon before dawn. The deadly strike took place in the town of Ansar, north of the coastal city of Tyre, according to the reports. Additionally, a series of airstrikes took place in the Nabatieh area, the reports say, including some of the heaviest strikes yet on the Ali Taher Ridge, beneath which Hezbollah has a major underground facility. The IDF has not yet commented on the reports.
events.summary:
Lebanese media reports six dead in an Israeli airstrike in southern Lebanon before dawn.

The deadly strike took place in the town of Ansar, north of the coastal city of Tyre, according to the reports.

Additionally, a series of airstrikes took place in the Nabatieh area, the reports say, including some of the heaviest strikes yet on the Ali Taher Ridge, beneath which Hezbollah has a major underground facility.

The IDF has not yet commented on the reports.
